data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for picking multiple images on iOS and Android
data.what_it_does: Provides a native multi‑image picker with album sorting, camera capture, and customizable UI. It returns a list of selected assets with optional metadata.
use_when: You need to let users select multiple photos from the gallery
You want a native‑looking picker with album grouping
You need camera capture inside the picker grid
You require control over image quality and metadata
avoid_when: You only need single image selection
You need advanced image editing or cropping
You target web or desktop platforms
strengths: Native performance via FishBun and BSImagePicker
Supports camera capture and album sorting
Allows metadata extraction and image quality control
data.setup_notes: Add NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription to Info.plist and WRITE/READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (or READ_MEDIA_IMAGES for SDK 33+) permissions to AndroidManifest.xml. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official plugin that supports single image picking and basic options; can be used if multi‑selection is not required

data.minimal_example:
resultList = await MultiImagePicker.pickImages(
  selectedAssets: images,
  cupertinoOptions: CupertinoOptions(
    doneButton: UIBarButtonItem(title: 'Confirm', tintColor: colorScheme.primary),
    cancelButton: UIBarButtonItem(title: 'Cancel', tintColor: colorScheme.primary),
    albumButtonColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
  ),
  materialOptions: const MaterialOptions(
    maxImages: 300,
    enableCamera: true,
    actionBarColor: "#abcdef",
    actionBarTitle: "Example App",
    allViewTitle: "All Photos",
    useDetailsView: false,
    selectCircleStrokeColor: "#000000",
  ),
);
